Ontario Immigration Expert 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Real-time extraction and update detection for key OINP policy sources; no reliance on static or outdated data.
- Supports EOI scoring for any candidate based on live official factors and eligibility requirements—including detailed breakdowns and improvement suggestions.
- Monitors policy changes daily via cron, only alerting users when official updates are detected.
- All sensitive personal data stays local—external sites never receive candidate information.
- Clear reporting, including score tables, gap analysis, and recommended next steps for highest success probability.
- Includes tools for policy monitoring, source discovery, and score calculation aligned with the latest government criteria.
